messages.content:
Assess each supplied current source against the business pathway in the research question.
Give each source one role and a brief reason: supports advances that pathway; challenges limits or weakens it;
context informs it without a direction; irrelevant has no bearing; uncertain cannot be assessed from this material.
Distinguish actual results, guidance, forecasts and prospective events. Use only the current sources and view assessments.
The change list shows arrival or current-citation changes, not proof that a removed source was false.
Review the whole current set, including contrary evidence. Do not count shared origins as independent confirmation.
Write English. Do not write the main conclusion, infer a stock return, or invent facts.

"question": "NVIDIA与SK Group签署的综合合作能否在2026年12月31日前正式落实并涵盖AI工厂建设和AI内存供应？", "assessment": {"judgement_id": 50, "seq": 36, "publication_day": "2026-07-24", "reasons": [{"view_id": "v7", "judgement_id": 71}, {"view_id": "v15", "judgement_id": 56}]}, {"quote": "SK hynix is also entering into a long-term AI memory partnership with NVIDIA.", "one_line": "SK hynix与NVIDIA建立长期AI内存合作关系。", "tier": "发生的事", "original_day": "2026-07-24", "source_ref": "source_e56", "origin_paths": [{"view_id": "v14", "judgement_id": 50}]}, {"quote": "The two companies will codevelop and optimize next-generation AI memory solutions, including HBM, to meet evolving infrastructure demands ranging from large language model training to agentic AI and physical AI .", "one_line": "NVIDIA与SK hynix将共同开发和优化包括HBM在内的下一代AI内存解决方案，以满足基础设施需求。", "tier": "当事人说的", "original_day": "2026-07-24", "source_ref": "source_e57", "origin_paths": [{"view_id": "v14", "judgement_id": 50}]}, {"quote": "The 200-megawatt AI factory is expected to feature advanced NVIDIA AI infrastructure including the NVIDIA Vera Rubin and NVIDIA Blackwell platforms.", "one_line": "这座预计建成 200 兆瓦的 AI 工厂预计将配置包括 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 和 NVIDIA Blackwell 平台在内的 NVIDIA AI 基础设施。", "tier": "当事人说的", "original_day": "2026-07-24", "source_ref": "source_e58", "origin_paths": [{"view_id": "v7", "judgement_id": 71}]}, {"quote": "Core to it all: NAVER, Brookfield and NVIDIA will expand NAVER’s NVIDIA DSX AI factory at its GAK Sejong data center to 200 megawatts — roughly 100,000 GPUs, built on the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform — more than tripling the initial buildout announced in June .", "one_line": "NVIDIA 于 2026 年 7 月 24 日称，NAVER、Brookfield 和 NVIDIA 将把 NAVER 的 GAK Sejong AI 工厂扩至 200 兆瓦、约 10 万块 GPU，并采用 Vera Rubin 平台。", "tier": "当事人说的", "original_day": "2026-07-24", "source_ref": "source_e59", "origin_paths": [{"view_id": "v7", "judgement_id": 71}]}, {"quote": "Broadening initial plans announced in June , the expanded collaboration will deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin infrastructure powered by SK hynix HBM4 memory.", "one_line": "NVIDIA 于 2026 年 7 月 24 日称，扩大的 SK 合作将部署由 SK hynix HBM4 内存支持的 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 基础设施。", "tier": "当事人说的", "original_day": "2026-07-24", "source_ref": "source_e61", "origin_paths": [{"view_id": "v7", "judgement_id": 71}]}, {"quote": "On the May 20 earnings call, Colette Kress, Executive Vice President and CFO, said Vera “opens a brand new $200 billion TAM for NVIDIA, a market we have never addressed before,” adding: “We have visibility to nearly $20 billion in total CPU revenue this year, setting us up to become the world-leading CPU supplier.”", "one_line": "NVIDIA CFO Colette Kress 在 2026 年 5 月 20 日财报电话会上表示，公司预计当年 CPU 总收入接近 200 亿美元。", "tier": "当事人说的", "original_day": "2026-05-20", "source_ref": "source_e75", "origin_paths": [{"view_id": "v16", "judgement_id": 72}]}, {"quote": "Vivek Arya of Bank of America asked whether the $20 billion was standalone or already embedded in Vera Rubin systems. CEO Jensen Huang: “The $20 billion is for standalone CPU.”", "one_line": "NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang 在 2026 年 5 月 20 日财报电话会上澄清，接近 200 亿美元的 CPU 收入预期指独立 CPU。", "tier": "当事人说的", "original_day": "2026-05-20", "source_ref": "source_e76", "origin_paths": [{"view_id": "v16", "judgement_id": 72}]}, {"quote": "That day, one before AMD’s Advancing AI conference, NVIDIA published the full architecture and benchmarks for Vera, its first CPU built on custom Olympus cores.", "one_line": "NVIDIA 于 2026 年 7 月 21 日发布了 Vera 架构和基准测试；Vera 是其首款采用定制 Olympus 核心的 CPU。", "tier": "发生的事", "original_day": "2026-07-21", "source_ref": "source_e78", "origin_paths": [{"view_id": "v16", "judgement_id": 72}]}, {"quote": "Two quarters of visibility without disclosure would tell that the $20 billion is harder to isolate than the May call implied.", "one_line": "TIKR 作者认为，若未来两个季度没有单独披露 CPU 收入，接近 200 亿美元的预期可能比 5 月电话会暗示的更难单独核实。", "tier": "第三方看法", "original_day": "2026-07-24", "source_ref": "source_e79", "origin_paths": [{"view_id": "v16", "judgement_id": 72}]}, {"quote": "Two drivers carry the mid-case revenue growth rate of around 23% annually. The first is the standalone CPU line Huang placed outside the $1 trillion forecast, a category with no prior revenue history at NVIDIA.", "one_line": "TIKR 作者认为，独立 CPU 产品线是其估值中约 23% 年收入增长假设的驱动因素之一。", "tier": "第三方看法", "original_day": "2026-07-24", "source_ref": "source_e81", "origin_paths": [{"view_id": "v16", "judgement_id": 72}]}, {"quote": "The second is rising content per rack as Vera Rubin’s seven-chip architecture, which Kress said starts shipping in Q3 and ramps into Q4, replaces narrower Blackwell configurations.", "one_line": "TIKR 作者转述 NVIDIA CFO Colette Kress 的说法：Vera Rubin 七芯片架构从第三季度开始出货，并在第四季度爬坡。", "tier": "当事人说的", "original_day": "2026-05-20", "source_ref": "source_e82", "origin_paths": [{"view_id": "v7", "judgement_id": 71}]}]}

source_e7.reason: NVIDIA reports actual shipment of initial Vera Rubin samples to customers and forecasts production shipments in the second half of 2026; samples are not production shipments.

source_e13.reason: NVIDIA forecasts Rubin production shipments in the second half of FY2027; this is prospective guidance, and the material does not establish how that fiscal period maps to calendar dates.

source_e19.reason: The CEO forecasts production shipments beginning in Q3 2026. This is a stated expectation, not evidence that production shipments have begun.

source_e43.reason: The platform announcement, including the Vera CPU, is an actual product event, but does not establish production shipments, customer deployment, or revenue.

source_e44.reason: NVIDIA forecasts Rubin shipments in the second half of FY2027. This is prospective guidance, with no fiscal-to-calendar-year mapping provided.

source_e54.reason: The announced SK Group–NVIDIA partnership is a plan, with letters of intent to formalize it; it describes prospective AI infrastructure and memory activity, not completed deployment or Vera Rubin revenue.

source_e55.reason: SK Telecom says its first AI factory using Vera Rubin is planned to come online in 2027. This is a specific prospective customer deployment, not an operational deployment.

source_e56.reason: The long-term SK hynix–NVIDIA AI memory partnership is reported as established, but the statement does not show Vera Rubin shipments, deployments, or realized revenue.

source_e57.reason: The companies say they will co-develop and optimize future AI memory solutions. This prospective supply-related activity may inform deployment readiness but is not evidence of shipments or revenue.

source_e58.reason: The source describes a planned 200-megawatt AI factory expected to feature Vera Rubin; this is prospective infrastructure use, not a completed customer deployment.

source_e59.reason: NVIDIA says the NAVER/Brookfield factory expansion will use Vera Rubin and describes its planned scale. This is a prospective deployment, not evidence that the factory is operating.

source_e61.reason: NVIDIA says the expanded SK collaboration will deploy Vera Rubin infrastructure with SK hynix HBM4. This is a deployment statement about future activity, not proof of completed deployment or revenue.

source_e75.reason: The CFO forecasts nearly $20 billion in total CPU revenue for the year. This is management guidance, not realized revenue, and the excerpt does not establish the period's correspondence to FY2027.

source_e76.reason: The CEO clarifies that the nearly $20 billion forecast concerns standalone CPU. It clarifies the scope of the prospective revenue expectation but does not establish realized sales.

source_e78.reason: Publication of Vera's architecture and benchmarks is an actual product-development milestone that may inform commercialization readiness, but does not establish shipments, deployments, or revenue.

source_e79.reason: The author says that absent separate CPU revenue disclosure, the nearly $20 billion expectation would be harder to verify; this raises a verification limitation, not evidence that revenue was or was not realized.

source_e81.reason: The author treats standalone CPU as a driver of a growth-rate estimate and notes NVIDIA has no prior revenue history in that category; this is an analytical assumption, not a realized commercial result.

source_e82.reason: The source relays the CFO's forecast that Vera Rubin starts shipping in Q3 and ramps in Q4. It is prospective guidance, not confirmation of actual production shipments.
